# Florida Paver Match

> Florida Paver Match is a free referral service that connects Florida homeowners with up to 3 independent local paver installation companies. It is not a contractor and does not perform paver installation work. Content cites Florida statutes, utility water-quality reports and city/county permit offices, and labels national estimates as such.

Last updated: 2026-11-21

## Key facts (sourced on the linked pages)
- St. Johns County allows pavers in county right-of-way for driveways but not as sidewalks; existing concrete sidewalks cannot be replaced with pavers; driveway connection permit fee $36 (SJC Development Review Manual s. 30).
- Jacksonville Beach handles paver driveway aprons through a Revocable Encroachment Permit signed by the property owner (City of Jacksonville Beach Public Works).
- Atlantic Beach requires a building permit for concrete slabs, pavers and patios that increase impervious area (City of Atlantic Beach).
- Fernandina Beach allows pavers in city right-of-way for driveways and sidewalks if they meet ASTM C902 or C936 (FDOT Section 526), with a notarized contractor certification before final inspection.
- Angi 2026 national average for a paver driveway: $12,000 (most pay $6,000-$18,000).
- Clearwater has a Right-of-Way Permit - Pavers application (about 7 business days) followed by a separate plan review (City of Clearwater Engineering).
- Winter Park requires a notarized Agreement for Installation of Non-Standard Driveway Access Apron, recorded with Orange County for $45, for paver aprons in the right-of-way (City of Winter Park).

## Guides
- [Paver driveway permits in Northeast Florida: county and city rules (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/guides/northeast-florida-paver-driveway-permits/): Right-of-way, encroachment and impervious-surface rules for pavers in St. Johns, Duval beaches, Clay and Fernandina Beach.
- [How much does a paver driveway cost? (2026 national data)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/guides/paver-driveway-cost-florida/): National paver driveway costs from Angi's 2026 data, plus the local permit fees you'll add in Northeast Florida.
- [Paver driveway permits and costs in Tampa Bay (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/guides/tampa-bay-paver-driveway-permits-costs/): What Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Dunedin and Tarpon Springs ask for before a paver driveway, plus 2026 national cost figures.
- [Paver driveway permits and costs around Orlando (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/guides/orlando-area-paver-driveway-permits-costs/): Winter Park, Oviedo, Sanford, Kissimmee, Winter Garden and Lake Mary: right-of-way permits, impervious limits and fees, plus 2026 national costs.

## Service areas
- [Paver Installation in St. Augustine, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/st-augustine/): Paver approvals here: inside city limits, permits come from the City of St. Augustine, not the county.
- [Paver Installation in World Golf Village, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/world-golf-village/): Paver approvals here: in unincorporated St. Johns County, pavers are allowed in the county right-of-way for driveways but not as sidewalks, existing concrete sidewalks cannot be removed or replaced with pavers, and the driveway connection permit is $36.
- [Paver Installation in Jacksonville Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/jacksonville-beach/): Paver approvals here: jacksonville Beach handles paver or specialty-concrete driveway aprons through a Revocable Encroachment Permit that only the property owner may sign.
- [Paver Installation in Atlantic Beach & Neptune Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/atlantic-beach-neptune-beach/): Paver approvals here: atlantic Beach requires a building permit for concrete slabs, pavers, patios and other uses that increase impervious area, and for driveways.
- [Paver Installation in Fleming Island, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/fleming-island/): Paver approvals here: clay County requires a driveway permit for any new, replacement, repair or paver upgrade that connects to county right-of-way; listed fees are $175 new, $150 change or upgrade and $75 existing or exemption.
- [Paver Installation in Orange Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/orange-park/): Paver approvals here: inside the Town of Orange Park, work in the town right-of-way uses the Streets Division application.
- [Paver Installation in Fernandina Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/fernandina-beach/): Paver approvals here: fernandina Beach allows pavers in city right-of-way for driveways and sidewalks if they meet FDOT Section 526 (ASTM C902 brick or C936 concrete pavers), with a notarized contractor certification before any final inspection.
- [Paver Installation in Tampa, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/tampa/): Tampa's driveway review maps nearby trees and may require a paver edge detail.
- [Paver Installation in St. Petersburg, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/st-petersburg/): St. Pete has a Permit Exemption form for qualifying single-family work under $7,500 outside flood hazard areas.
- [Paver Installation in Clearwater, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/clearwater/): Clearwater has a Right-of-Way Permit - Pavers application; driveways and patios also need a building permit.
- [Paver Installation in Largo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/largo/): Largo's residential driveway permit needs a survey or site plan with dimensions and a material description.
- [Paver Installation in Dunedin, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/dunedin/): Dunedin permit fee: 0.80% of construction value, minimum $60, plus 25% plan review.
- [Paver Installation in Tarpon Springs, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/tarpon-springs/): Pavers in the Tarpon Springs right-of-way need a Right-of-Way Driveway Paver Agreement.
- [Paver Installation in Winter Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/winter-park/): Paver aprons in Winter Park's right-of-way need a recorded non-standard driveway agreement ($45 recording fee).
- [Paver Installation in Oviedo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/oviedo/): Oviedo's Right of Way Type I permit is $79 plus a $25 tech fee and needs a sealed boundary survey.
- [Paver Installation in Sanford, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/sanford/): Sanford charges $40 for a single-family right-of-way driveway; Public Works inspects driveways.
- [Paver Installation in Kissimmee, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/kissimmee/): Kissimmee right-of-way permits start at $25; open cuts in paved streets are $150.
- [Paver Installation in Winter Garden, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/winter-garden/): Winter Garden paver and driveway work needs a Zoning Compliance Review with an ISR worksheet.
- [Paver Installation in Lake Mary, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-paver-match/pavers/lake-mary/): Lake Mary charges $50 for a residential driveway connection outside a building permit.
